title: How to Make Friends
description: Outside the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, a Scion of the Canopy seems to be troubled about something...

mainQuestExcel.title: How to Make Friends
mainQuestExcel.description: Outside the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, a Scion of the Canopy seems to be troubled about something...

dialogs.text: That poor little Yumkasaurus... That does it. I'll show them. I'll show those scoundrels!
You can run, you louts, but you can't hide!
What happened?
You're... a traveler from afar, then? Greetings to you — though I fear I cannot extend any hospitality to you beyond that.
Those wretched Treasure Hoarders were aiming to catch that little Yumkasaurus again. Fortunately, I was on hand to chase them off.
But the poor thing's been scared stiff. He won't come any closer no matter how I call out.
No matter. I've found their hideout. I'm going to teach them a lesson, and once I do, I'll have 'em lashed to a tree, and lashed with one too!
Also, I'll have to find something tasty to comfort that poor little frightened Yumkasaurus...
I'd suggest you focus on the comforting.
Hmm... You do speak sense. That poor child has been terrified enough. Alright. Let's go calm him down first...
Come along, then. From the look of you, you must be an experienced adventurer.
With the two of us there, those thieves won't dare try anything. And don't worry about payment. I know the Guild's rules, and I'll follow them.
That little one just loves eating Candlecap Mushrooms... And if I recall, lots of them grow under the tree over there. Why don't you start by picking some?
I'll be gathering Candlecap Mushrooms on the other side. Once you're done with yours, let's meet up on the cliff near the Stadium.
That's where the little Saurian usually takes a break. Perhaps we can find him there.
Let's go teach those Treasure Hoarders a lesson.
You're willing to come along? Thank you! And you'd be a big help, too — I can tell you're an experienced adventurer.
I'll be sure to pay you as the Adventurers' Guild rules stipulate. Let's go then — we'll show those scoundrels.
#We meet again, {NICKNAME}. Well, then, what do you say to lending me a hand, just like last time?
Those Treasure Hoarders never learn their lesson, do they? If we leave them be, they'll only be emboldened to continue doing evil.
The little Yumkasaurus is safe for now, but he's still a young 'un. He still needs more care...
I'd suggest you focus on the comforting.
Alright. That'll cheer him up, I hope.
Those Treasure Hoarders shouldn't come looking for trouble with both of us around.
Let me think for a moment... please go to the tree over there and pick two fresh Candlecap Mushrooms.
Once you've gathered them, let's meet up at the cliff near the Stadium again. Those Treasure Hoarders won't try anything funny with you there.
Let's go teach those Treasure Hoarders a lesson.
No problem. Those unrepentant Treasure Hoarders just set up a new camp — I've marked it out.
I'll pay you based on Adventurers' Guild rules. Let's get going, shall we?

flow.stepDescription: Go to the cliffside to look for Tlamot

dialogs.text: This is where he normally hangs out, but there's not a trace of him today...
He must've hidden after that scare.
Should we go searching for him?
...Nah. Let's leave him in peace for a while. We'll just leave the mushrooms here.
You've got experience, I see...
In taking care of that kid? Definitely. I've been looking after him for a while now, so I know he's a sensitive sort. Even the sight of strangers might spook him.
Only after I fed him for a long time was he willing to approach me... But I doubt he'll be coming out any time soon, now that those villains have made a mess of everything.
We'll need to leave him alone for a while.
Thanks for coming along. Here's the reward.
It's just a pity that we couldn't see him.
Don't worry, he remembers those who've done right by him. When the time is right, he will definitely come to see us.
I'd love to have met that little Yumkasaurus.
...Shh. Look over there. He's waiting for us.
...Woo? Mmwoo...?
Come here, kiddo. We're not gonna hurt ya.
Mwoo? Mmmmrawr...
I'm Tlamot. Remember me? I'm the one who gave you those delicious treats before.
#And I'm {NICKNAME}.
Roar... Rawrrrr!
You play with the happy Yumkasaurus for a while. It seems he's in a much better mood...
Raar! Oroo, rrooh!
#This... Hey, {NICKNAME}, looks like he sees you as a friend already! We both got gifts too.
Rawr! Rawr!
Thanks a lot.
Rawr! Rawrrr! Rawr!
The little Yumkasaurus happily circles you twice before turning and diving into the woods once more.
Looks like he's gone home. Just hope he doesn't run into any more of those scoundrels.
Let's head back as well. Here, take these as compensation.
Two rounds of compensation for one commission.
Well, then you'd best keep the share you got from our little Yumkasaurus well. As for what I gave you... Haha, just spend it on whatever you want.
Well, this was a profitable excursion.
And I found some of said delicious treats.
Ah, he's gone... Oh well. Let's just leave the Candlecap Mushrooms here.
It's just a pity that we couldn't see him.
Rawr! Rawrrr! Rawr...
Hmm? I think I hear something.
Let's just let him be for now. Maybe he'll be willing to come closer to us once he's grown a bit.
Regardless, the important thing is that he's living a happy life.
Hey there— We're heading off!
We're heading off!
Ah yes, take this. You deserve this much as thanks for your help.
I do hope that kid grows up soon — that way, he can just send those Treasure Hoarders flying with a couple of kicks!
See you next time!
Is he hiding around the corner?
I'd love to have seen that little Yumkasaurus again.

flow.stepDescription: Teach the Treasure Hoarders a lesson

dialogs.text: Hmph. Let's see them dare to hurt my little Yumkasaurus ever again, eh?
Feels like there's been some sort of misunderstanding...
Don't listen to their pretty words. Why, I saw them tie a rope to that poor Yumkasaurus's tail with my own eyes!
Who knows what might have happened if I hadn't shown up when I had.
Thanks for your aid, in any case. Here's your payment.
It's just a shame they fled so fast. If we'd caught them, we could put an end to their troublemaking once and for all!
...Shh. Look over there. He's waiting for us.
Friend...? Don't know... Good people...?
Come here, kiddo. We're not gonna hurt ya.
Good people...? Friends...
I'm Tlamot. Remember me? I'm the one who gave you those delicious treats before.
#Hi, I'm {NICKNAME}.
And I found some of said delicious treats.
You... Friend!
You play with the happy Yumkasaurus for a while. It seems he's in a much better mood...
For you, for you, gift!
#This is... Heh, looks like we both got presents, eh, {NICKNAME}?
Friend, thank you!
Thank you!
Friend! Friend! Good! Good! See you again!
The little Yumkasaurus happily circles you twice before turning and diving into the woods once more.
Looks like he's gone home. Just hope he doesn't run into any more of those scoundrels.
Let's head back as well. Here, take these as compensation.
Two rounds of compensation for one commission.
Well, this was a profitable excursion.
Well, then you'd best keep the share you got from our little Yumkasaurus well. As for what I gave you... Haha, just spend it on whatever you want.
Rawr!? Hrrrooor, rawr!
Thank you!
Wooo... Rawr! Wooo... Raawrrr!
The little Yumkasaurus dives into the woods faster than you've ever seen it move, and disappears from your sight...
It's a great gift!
Haha, then you'd best take care of the Embercore Flower he gave you, alright?
I do hope that kid grows up soon — that way, he can just send those Treasure Hoarders flying with a couple of kicks!
Don't worry, he remembers those who've done right by him. When the time is right, he will definitely come to see us.
Been found! Friend! Gift!
Thank you!
Friend, like, happy... See you!
The little Yumkasaurus dives into the woods faster than you've ever seen it move, and disappears from your sight...
It's a great gift!

The little Yumkasaurus happily circles you twice before turning and diving into the woods once more.
